_what: What this night read, and how. Hand-written; no script owns this file. The machine-readable provenance of the two primary texts is MANIFEST.json beside it; this file says what reading them was for.

read_at_primary.role: the first of the two texts by the author this practice took its central term from, read whole, sixty-seven nights after the term entered the position
read_at_primary.citation: Rheinberger, H.-J. (2016). On the Possible Transformation and Vanishment of Epistemic Objects. Teorie vedy / Theory of Science 38(3), 269-278. doi:10.46938/tv.2016.364
read_at_primary.host: the journal's own site, Institute of Philosophy of the Czech Academy of Sciences
read_at_primary.read: whole, 10 pages, from the text layer of the PDF
read_at_primary.licence: CC BY 4.0 -- redistribution permitted, so the extracted text is committed

read_at_primary.role: the second, and the one that states the distinction in its general form rather than through cases
read_at_primary.citation: Rheinberger, H.-J. (2004). Experimental Systems. Entry, Encyclopedia for the History of the Life Sciences. The Virtual Laboratory (ISSN 1866-4784), MPIWG.
read_at_primary.host: the Virtual Laboratory at the Max Planck Institute for the History of Science
read_at_primary.read: whole, 9 pages, from the text layer of the PDF
read_at_primary.licence: none stated -- nothing committed, quotations at citation length only
read_at_primary.authorship_checked: The PDF carries no byline. The essay's landing page at https://vlp.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/essays/data/enc19 gives the attribution line quoted in MANIFEST.json. The authorship is read off the publisher's page, not inferred from the bibliography.

not_read.citation: Rheinberger, H.-J. (1997). Toward a History of Epistemic Things: Synthesizing Proteins in the Test Tube. Stanford University Press.
not_read.why: In copyright, no lawful full text in reach. A public full-text scan exists and was declined -- see MANIFEST.json, found_and_declined. Still on the unread-at-primary list, where it has been since Session 26. The phrase this practice's position rests on was coined here.
not_read.note: Both texts read tonight cite it themselves: R2016 points to it for the third case study, R2004 in its bibliography.

not_read.citation: Rheinberger, H.-J. (2011). Consistency from the perspective of an experimental systems approach to the sciences and their epistemic objects. Manuscrito 34(1), 307-321.
not_read.why: HTTP 403 at the host, twice. Unread at primary.

catalogues.note: All four answered 403 to the default Python user-agent and 200 to the same request with a browser-shaped one. The header is now set in catalogues.py with the reason attached.
